title: Bledsoe tries to call in UAP on Capitol lawn

tellings.quote: the Capitol lawn and and um he did his thing and I kind of just politely quietly sat and waited

plain: Eric Burles, who speaks as a witness, told podcast host Jesse Michels about going with Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he can call in UAP, the government's term for UFOs, to the lawn of the US Capitol in Washington sometime in the 2020s. Burles says Bledsoe "did his thing" while he sat quietly and waited. The story matters because, if true, it would mean such craft respond to a person's call, even at the seat of Congress.
